headline: Rail link between Dhaka and North Bengal snapped after train derailment in Pabna
summary: The Ekota Express derailed near Ishwardi Bypass Railway Station, halting services and leaving several trains stranded.
details: A Panchagarh-bound Ekota Express intercity train derailed near the Ishwardi Bypass Railway Station in Pabna this afternoon.
The derailment occurred at the Majhgram area at around 4:00 PM, causing a complete halt in rail services between Dhaka and the northern districts.
The Ekota Express departed the spot at approximately 5:00 PM, leaving the derailed carriage behind for recovery operations.
A railway relief train arrived at the site by 6:00 PM to begin rescue and recovery work.
Due to the incident, several trains remained stranded at various stations along the route.
Pakshi Divisional Railway Manager Abu Hena Mostafa Alam stated that train movement would resume shortly via a diversion.
Dhaka-bound and North Bengal-bound trains will be diverted to the Ishwardi railway junction instead of the Ishwardi Bypass station to reach their destinations.
caption:

A Panchagarh-bound Ekota Express intercity train derailed near the Ishwardi Bypass Railway Station in Pabna this afternoon.

The derailment occurred at the Majhgram area at around 4:00 PM, causing a complete halt in rail services between Dhaka and the northern districts.

The Ekota Express departed the spot at approximately 5:00 PM, leaving the derailed carriage behind for recovery operations.

A railway relief train arrived at the site by 6:00 PM to begin rescue and recovery work.

Due to the incident, several trains remained stranded at various stations along the route.

Pakshi Divisional Railway Manager Abu Hena Mostafa Alam stated that train movement would resume shortly via a diversion.

Dhaka-bound and North Bengal-bound trains will be diverted to the Ishwardi railway junction instead of the Ishwardi Bypass station to reach their destinations.

headline: 5 hurt as ceiling plaster collapses at Bagerhat court
summary: The injured, including two with head wounds, were rushed to the district hospital after plaster fell from the ground floor veranda of the judge court building.
details: Five men were injured this afternoon after plaster collapsed from the ceiling of a veranda at the Bagerhat District and Sessions Judge Court building.
The incident occurred on the ground floor veranda in front of the Kachua Court courtroom, where judicial magistrates conduct proceedings.
The injured were identified as Habibullah Sheikh, Md Siraj Sheikh, Suman Das, Hridoy Hawlader, and Motaleb, all residents of Bagerhat district.
According to hospital superintendent Dr Asim Kumar Samaddar, two victims required stitches for head injuries, while others sustained injuries to their necks and legs.
The victims are currently out of danger and are being treated at the Bagerhat 250-bed District Hospital.
Following the collapse, reinforcing steel rods were exposed in the ceiling, raising fears of further accidents in the building.
Public prosecutor MM Mahabub Morshed Lalon noted that the three-storey building is old and has developed cracks in several areas.
The Public Works Department (PWD) has been informed and will inspect the site to determine if the building is fit for use and conduct urgent repairs.
